fields.name: email
fields.attributes: @unique // nullable — a user may register with phone instead

fields.name: phoneNormalized
fields.attributes: @unique // digits-only form of `phone`, used as an alternate login identifier when no email is set

fields.name: thumbnail
fields.attributes: // base64 data URL or external URL

fields.name: photo
fields.attributes: // URL or base64 of student photo

fields.name: nameKh
fields.attributes: // Khmer name — captured at self-registration; User.name stays the English name used for display

fields.name: customFieldValues
fields.attributes: // { [ClassRegistrationField.key]: string } — copied over from ClassRegistration on approval

fields.name: email
fields.attributes: // at least one of email/phone is required — see createRegistration

fields.name: passwordHash
fields.attributes: // bcrypt hash of the password the student chose, or an auto-generated one — see passwordMode

fields.name: generatedPassword
fields.attributes: // plaintext, set ONLY when auto-generated (never for a student-chosen password), so an admin can relay it

fields.name: photo
fields.attributes: // base64 data URL, same convention as Student.photo

fields.name: sex
fields.attributes: // MALE or FEMALE — required unless hidden/optional via ClassRegistrationSettings.sexMode

fields.name: emailMode
fields.attributes: @default("REQUIRED") // REQUIRED | OPTIONAL | HIDDEN — emailMode and phoneMode can't both be HIDDEN (no way to create a login otherwise)

fields.name: passwordMode
fields.attributes: @default("REQUIRED") // REQUIRED | OPTIONAL | HIDDEN — non-REQUIRED means a password is auto-generated when the student doesn't set one

fields.name: key
fields.attributes: @unique // slug used as the JSON key in ClassRegistration.customFieldValues

fields.name: options
fields.attributes: // string[] — choices shown when fieldType is SELECT, ignored otherwise

fields.name: logoUrl
fields.attributes: // base64 data URL or external URL

fields.name: actorId
fields.attributes: // null for anonymous / system events (e.g. failed login attempt)

fields.name: changes
fields.attributes: // { before: {...}, after: {...} } or array of diffs

fields.name: subject
fields.attributes: // e.g. "Math", "English" — which lesson this fee is for

fields.name: maxOnDay
fields.attributes: // Max lessons allowed on one day

fields.name: classTeacherId
fields.attributes: // FK to TimetableClass (no unique — multiple teachers can share a class)

fields.name: title
fields.attributes: // job title / position, e.g. "Senior English Teacher"

fields.name: type
fields.attributes: @default("MCQ") // MCQ | TF | see backend/src/h5p/h5p-questions.ts for the shared H5P types

fields.name: data
fields.attributes: // type-specific config, e.g. MCQ: { choices:[{id,text,isCorrect}], multiple }, TF: { correct }

fields.name: manualMarks
fields.attributes: // { questionId: number } — teacher-graded marks for non-MCQ questions

fields.name: attemptNumber
fields.attributes: @default(0) // bumped on each submit — gated against Exam.maxAttempts, same convention as AssignmentSubmission

fields.name: data
fields.attributes: // type-specific config (choices, correct answer, pairs, tolerance, etc.)

fields.name: status
fields.attributes: @default("DRAFT") // DRAFT, PUBLISHED, ENROLLMENT, ACTIVE, COMPLETED, ARCHIVED

fields.name: videoWatchPct
fields.attributes: @default(90) // % of video required to count as finished

fields.name: maxAttempts
fields.attributes: @default(0) // 0 = unlimited (the pre-existing behavior) — caps how many times a student can retake this lesson

fields.name: content
fields.attributes: // page-type specific body (html/markdown, question payload, branch rules)

fields.name: answer
fields.attributes: // student-submitted answer (shape depends on question type)

fields.name: pointsAwarded
fields.attributes: // null = pending manual grade (Essay questions only)

fields.name: nextPageId
fields.attributes: // page the player was sent to after this response

fields.name: checkInCode
fields.attributes: // optional code students enter to self-check-in

fields.name: invoiceFooter
fields.attributes: @default("This is a computer-generated invoice. No signature required.")

fields.name: aboutTitle
fields.attributes: @default("A Smarter Way to Manage Your School")

templateExpressions:
`Hello ${user.name},

Use this link within 30 minutes to reset your password:
${url}

If you did not request this, ignore this message.`

deliveries.recipientExpression: { to: parent.email, from: this.config.email.from, subject: 'Student Absence Notification', text: message, }
{ body: message, from: this.config.sms.from, to: parent.phone, }

externalFlows.name: Email provider (SendGrid)
externalFlows.data: Recipient address and name, and message text that can name a student.

externalFlows.name: Remote images fetched by the image proxy
externalFlows.data: The requested image URL only; no school records.

externalFlows.name: S3-compatible object storage
externalFlows.data: Plugin-owned files, which may hold any plugin's personal or student data.

externalFlows.name: SendGrid and Twilio account checks during installation preflight
externalFlows.data: The school's own provider credentials, sent to that provider to verify them; no personal data.

externalFlows.name: The school's own API, reached through the web app's server-side proxy
externalFlows.data: Every school record; stays inside the installation.

externalFlows.name: SMS provider (Twilio)
externalFlows.data: Recipient phone number, and message text that can name a student.

externalFlows.name: Wattanam marketplace
externalFlows.data: Installation identity and signed requests, plugin orders, and platform-bill payment submissions: amount, bank reference, receipt image and the submitting administrator's name.

externalFlows.name: Wattanam update repository
externalFlows.data: Release and advisory metadata requests; no school records.
